title: The 17-Year-Old Who Hacked GTA 6 With An Amazon Fire Stick
sources: BBC News / Southwark Crown Court (December 2023) - Sentencing of Lapsus$ hacker Arion Kurtaj for GTA 6 breach.
Reuters / The Guardian - Hacker breached Rockstar Games Slack using Amazon Fire Stick from Travelodge hotel room.

lines.text: How did a seventeen-year-old leak ninety videos of GTA Six -
lines.caps: How did a 17-YEAR-OLD | leak GTA 6 | using only | an Amazon Fire Stick?

lines.text: while locked inside a hotel room with NO computer?
In September twenty twenty-two, the gaming world exploded -
when raw gameplay clips of Grand Theft Auto Six were dumped all over the internet.
The hacker was Arion Kurtaj, a member of the infamous cyber gang Lapsus$.
Here is the insane part: Kurtaj had ALREADY been arrested -
and was living under police bail in a budget Travelodge hotel room.
British police had confiscated all his laptops and phones to keep him offline.
So Kurtaj bought an Amazon Fire TV stick, plugged it into the hotel television,
connected a keyboard, mouse, and used a burner phone as a wireless hotspot!
He broke into Rockstar Games' internal Slack channels,
stole ninety confidential videos, and posted directly on their company chat:
"I am not a Rockstar employee. Message me on Telegram or I release the source code."
It became the biggest video game leak in history.
